purpose_context: The analyzer's precision work (#4/#11) made it structurally blind to failure modes no fingerprint anticipates. This mission adds a deterministic, residual-only Tier-3 trap that captures genuinely-unclassified output/structured distress signals, reports them separately from confirmed findings, and feeds a promote/refine/ignore self-improvement loop — recall insurance that never lowers precision.
purpose_tldr: Add a segregated Tier-3 unclassified-anomaly channel so the analyzer surfaces novel failure modes without inflating confirmed-failure counts.
